description: Implementation of a PHP stream wrapper for Amazon S3, enabling file-like access to S3 objects using 's3://' URLs. The class provides methods for opening, reading, writing, seeking, and managing S3 objects and buckets through PHP stream functions.

classes.name: StreamWrapper
classes.description: A PHP stream wrapper for Amazon S3 that allows reading and writing files directly on S3 using URL streams, supporting various modes such as read, write, append, with capabilities for directory listing and object management.

methods.name: register
methods.description: Registers the 's3://' stream wrapper with a specified S3 client and optional cache, enabling the use of s3 URLs in PHP file functions.

methods.name: stream_close
methods.description: Closes the current stream, flushing buffers if necessary.

methods.name: stream_open
methods.description: Opens a stream to an S3 object with a specified mode ('r', 'w', 'a', 'x'), initializing necessary parameters and validating permissions.

methods.name: stream_eof
methods.description: Checks if the end of the stream has been reached.

methods.name: stream_flush
methods.description: Flushes the stream buffers, finalizing data upload to S3.

methods.name: stream_read
methods.description: Reads data from the stream.

methods.name: stream_seek
methods.description: Seeks to a position within the stream.

methods.name: stream_tell
methods.description: Returns the current position within the stream.

methods.name: stream_write
methods.description: Writes data to the stream.

methods.name: unlink
methods.description: Deletes an object from S3.

methods.name: stream_stat
methods.description: Returns status information about a stream.

methods.name: url_stat
methods.description: Provides information about a specific URL, such as file size, modification time, etc., for use with file system functions.

methods.name: initProtocol
methods.description: Parses the URL to initialize the protocol component.

methods.name: createStat
methods.description: Creates a stat array for a given S3 path.

methods.name: statDirectory
methods.description: Performs stat operation on directories or buckets.

methods.name: mkdir
methods.description: Creates a new bucket or pseudo-folder in S3.

methods.name: rmdir
methods.description: Deletes a bucket or an empty pseudo-folder.

methods.name: dir_opendir
methods.description: Opens a directory for listing objects with optional filtering.

methods.name: dir_closedir
methods.description: Closes the directory stream.

methods.name: dir_rewinddir
methods.description: Rewinds the directory stream.

methods.name: dir_readdir
methods.description: Reads the next entry in a directory listing.

methods.name: rename
methods.description: Renames an object within S3.

methods.name: stream_cast
methods.description: Used to cast resource to object; not implemented.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates stream parameters and modes before opening.

methods.name: getOptions
methods.description: Retrieves stream context options.

methods.name: getOption
methods.description: Retrieves a specific stream context option.

methods.name: getClient
methods.description: Gets the S3 client object from the stream context.

methods.name: getBucketKey
methods.description: Extracts bucket and key from the URL.

methods.name: withPath
methods.description: Combines URL and parameters for operations.

methods.name: openReadStream
methods.description: Opens a read stream to an S3 object.

methods.name: openWriteStream
methods.description: Prepares a stream for writing to S3.

methods.name: openAppendStream
methods.description: Opens a stream for appending data to an existing S3 object.

methods.name: triggerError
methods.description: Triggers a PHP warning or error with provided messages.

methods.name: formatUrlStat
methods.description: Prepares a stat array for a URL or object.

methods.name: createBucket
methods.description: Creates a new S3 bucket.

methods.name: createSubfolder
methods.description: Creates a pseudo-folder (empty object) in S3.

methods.name: deleteSubfolder
methods.description: Deletes a subfolder if empty.

methods.name: determineAcl
methods.description: Determines the appropriate ACL based on file mode.

methods.name: getStatTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template array for stat results.

methods.name: boolCall
methods.description: Executes a callable and catches exceptions, converting them to false.

methods.name: getCacheStorage
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes the cache storage.

methods.name: clearCacheKey
methods.description: Removes a specific cache entry for a given key.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Retrieves size of current object body.
